data.name: Jemimiah
data.gender_notes: Jemimiah is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Jemimiah means 'dove' or 'gracious gift'. In the Old Testament, Jemimah was a descendant of Jesse and the mother of Zophar, one of King Solomon's friends. Her name signifies the gentle and nurturing spirit of a dove, as well as the gracious gift that God bestows upon us. The name Jemimiah carries the meaning “Dove, Gracious Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Jemimiah usually hope their child will grow to embody dove, gracious gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jemimiah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dove, Gracious Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jemimiah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: יממיה
in_hebrew.meaning: השם יממיהו הוא שילוב של ים ו-יהו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יממיהו הוא שילוב של המילה 'ים' שיכולה להתפרש כים או מערב, ו-יהו שהוא קיצור של השם יהוה, אלוהי ישראל. הנושא של שם זה עשוי להיות קשור לים או לגבולות המערביים של ארץ ישראל, וגם קשור לשם האלוקים.

in_greek.name: Ιεμιμίας
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Ιεμιμίας σημαίνει θάλασσα ή Δυτικός τόπος του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιεμιμίας προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές λέξεις 'ים' (θάλασσα ή δυτικός τόπος) και 'יהו' (σύντομη μορφή του Θεού). Στη Βίβλο, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με τη θάλασσα ή τα δυτικά σύνορα της γης Ισραήλ και συμβολίζει τη δύναμη και τη μεγαλοσύνη του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Jemimiah
in_latin.meaning: The name Jemimiah means sea or western place of God
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Jemimiah is derived from the Hebrew words 'yam' (sea or western place) and 'Yah' (short form of God). In the biblical context, this name is associated with the sea or the western borders of Israel and signifies the power and majesty of God.

in_english.name: Jemimiah
in_english.meaning: Sea or western place of God, derived from Hebrew roots

Historically, the name Jemimiah is found in biblical contexts, symbolizing spiritual strength and divine guidance. In Christian tradition, it represents a strong, faith-driven personality.
